mnd6:74.13: kulaṃ gaṇaṃ āvāsaṃ lābham yasaṃ pasaṃsaṃ sukhaṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ
mnd6:74.14: kāmadhātuṃ rūpadhātuṃ arūpadhātuṃ kāmabhavaṃ rūpabhavaṃ arūpabhavaṃ saññābhavaṃ asaññābhavaṃ nevasaññā-nāsaññābhavaṃ
mnd6:74.17: diṭṭhasutamutāviññātabbe dhamme anissito asannissito anallīno anupagato anajjhosito anadhimutto nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī ti,
mnd6:75.1: Na piyaṃ kubbati no pi appiyan ti.
mnd6:75.5: Idha yassa te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukāmā yogakkhemakāmā, mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā putto vā dhītā vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātī vā sālohitā vā,
mnd6:75.8: Manāpikā rūpā, manāpikā saddā, manāpikā gandhā, manāpikā rasā, manāpikā phoṭṭhabbā;
mnd6:75.13: Idha yassa te honti anatthakāmā ahitakāmā aphāsukāmā ayogakkhemakāmā jīvitā voropetukāmā,
mnd6:75.16: Amanāpikā rūpā, amanāpikā saddā, amanāpikā gandhā, amanāpikā rasā, amanāpikā phoṭṭhabbā;
mnd6:75.18: Na piyaṃ kubbati no pi appiyan ti.
mnd6:75.19: Ayaṃ me satto piyo, ime ca me saṃkhārā manāpā ti bhaṅgavasena piyaṃ na karoti.
mnd6:75.20: Ayaṃ me satto appiyo, ime ca me saṃkhārā amanāpā ti paṭighavasena appiyaṃ na karoti na janeti na sañjaneti na nibbatteti nābhinibbattetī ti,
mnd6:75.21: na piyaṃ kubbati no pi appiyaṃ.
mnd6:76.1: Tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpatī ti.
mnd6:76.2: Tasmin ti tasmiṃ puggale arahante khīṇāsave.
mnd6:76.3: Paridevo ti ñātibyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, bhogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, rogabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, sīlabyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa, diṭṭhibyasanenā vā phuṭṭhassa, aññataraññatarena vā byasanena samannāgatassa, aññataraññatarena vā dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ vācāpalāpo vippalāpo lālappo lālappāyanā lālappāyitattaṃ.
mnd6:76.6: yaṃ evarūpaṃ macchariyaṃ maccharāyanā maccharāyitattaṃ vevicchaṃ kadariyaṃ kaṭukañcakatā aggahitattaṃ cittassa;
mnd6:76.8: Api ca khandhamacchariyam pi macchariyaṃ, dhātumacchariyaṃ pi macchariyaṃ, āyatanamacchariyaṃ pi macchariyaṃ. Gāho
mnd6:77.1: Paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpatī ti.
mnd6:77.4: Yathā vāri padumapatte na limpati na saṃlimpati n' upalimpati, alittaṃ asaṃlittaṃ anupalittaṃ; evaṃ eva tasmiṃ puggale arahante khīṇāsave paridevo ca macchariyañ ca na limpati na saṃlimpati n' upalimpati, alittā asaṃlittā anupalittā;
mnd6:77.5: so ca puggalo tehi kilesehi na limpati na saṃlimpati n' upalimpati, alitto asaṃlitto anupalitto nikkhanto nissaṭṭho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī ti,
mnd6:77.6: tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati.

mnd6:86.1: Dhono na hi tena maññati yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃmutesu vā ti.
mnd6:86.3: yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi.
mnd6:86.5: Tāya paññāya kāyaduccaritaṃ dhutañ ca dhotañ ca sandhotañ ca niddhotañ ca,
mnd6:86.6: vacīduccaritaṃ dhutañ ca dhotañ ca sandhotañ ca niddhotañ ca,
mnd6:86.7: manoduccaritaṃ dhutañ ca dhotañ ca sandhotañ ca niddhotañ ca,
mnd6:86.8: rāgo dhuto ca dhoto ca sandhoto ca niddhoto ca,
mnd6:86.30: sabbākusalābhisaṃkhārā dhutā ca dhotā ca sandhotā ca niddhotā ca.
mnd6:87.1: Athavā sammādiṭṭhiyā micchādiṭṭhi dhutā ca dhotā ca sandhotā ca niddhotā ca;
mnd6:87.2: sammāsaṃkappena micchāsaṃkappo dhuto ca dhoto ca sandhoto ca niddhoto ca,

mnd6:88.1: Athavā ariyena aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena sabbe kilesā,
mnd6:88.6: sabbākusalābhisaṃkhārā dhutā ca dhotā ca sandhotā ca niddhotā ca.
mnd6:88.7: Arahā imehi dhoneyyehi dhammehi upeto samupeto upagato samupagato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato;
mnd6:88.9: So dhutarāgo dhutapāpo dhutakileso dhutapariḷāho ti,
mnd6:89.1: Dhono na hi tena maññati yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃmutesu vā ti
mnd6:89.2: dhono diṭṭhaṃ na maññati, diṭṭhasmiṃ na maññati, diṭṭhato na maññati, diṭṭhaṃ me ti na maññati;
mnd6:89.3: sutaṃ na maññati, sutasmiṃ na maññati, sutato na maññati, sutaṃ me ti na maññati;
mnd6:89.4: mutaṃ na maññati, mutasmiṃ na maññati, mutato na maññati, mutaṃ me ti na maññati;
mnd6:89.5: viññātaṃ na maññati, viññātasmiṃ na maññati, viññātato na maññati, viññātaṃ me ti na maññati.
mnd6:89.7: *Asmī ti bhikkhave maññitam etaṃ, ayam aham asmī ti maññitam etaṃ, bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ, na bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ, rūpī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ, arūpī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ, saññī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ, asaññī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ, nevasaññi-nāsaññī bhavissan ti maññitam etaṃ;
mnd6:89.8: maññitaṃ bhikkhave rogo, maññitaṃ gaṇḍo, maññitaṃ sallaṃ, maññitaṃ upaddavo;
mnd6:89.9: tasmā ti ha bhikkhave amaññamānena cetasā viharissāmā ti evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabban ti,
mnd6:89.10: dhono na hi tena maññati yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃmutesu vā.
mnd6:90.2: Dhono aññena asuddhimaggena micchāpaṭipadāya aniyyānikapathena, aññatra satipaṭṭhānehi, aññatra sammappadhānehi, aññatra iddhippādehi, aññatra indriyehi, aññatra balehi, aññatra bojjhaṅgehi, aññatra ariyā aṭṭhaṅgikā maggā, suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ na icchati, na assādiyati, na pattheti, na piheti, na samijjhati, nābhijappatī ti,
mnd6:91.1: Na hi so rajjati no virajjatī ti.
mnd6:91.2: Sabbe bālaputhujjanā rajjanti; kalyāṇaputhujjanam upādāya satta sekhā virajjanti;
mnd6:91.3: arahā n' eva rajjati, no virajjati,
mnd6:91.4: virato so, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā, khayā dosassa vītadosattā, khayā mohassa vītamohattā.
mnd6:91.5: So vuṭṭhavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo . . . pe . . . n' atthi tassa punabbhavo ti,
mnd6:91.6: na hi so rajjati no virajjati.
